desc:
🎴 Open packs, collect stickers and complete your ultimate football album!

💎Collect cards across 5 different rarities: 🔵 Base · 🟤 Bronze · ⚪ Silver · 🟡 Gold · ✨ Shiny
🔄 Trade with other players and swap cards to hunt down the ones you're missing.
🏆 Complete albums to unlock exclusive rewards: titles, auras, cosmetics and the legendary Trophy.
⚡ Rebirth the base album up to 5 times to earn permanent advantages and prove you're the greatest collector.
🎮 Play minigames, earn coins, open more packs and climb the leaderboard.
👍Like the game and join the community for codes and benefits!

✨ Do you have what it takes to become the World Champion?
